title: services: villages views (get_village_view, get_slot_view)
criteria:
APPEND two functions to the END of the existing realm/services/villages.py (use the Edit tool; do NOT change, reorder or rewrite any existing function or constant; add new imports at the top only if needed): get_village_view(s, player_id, village_id, now, cfg) -> VillageView and get_slot_view(s, player_id, village_id, slot, now, cfg) -> SlotView (models in realm/services/views.py). Tests go in the NEW file tests/services/test_village_views.py (DB fixtures `s`, `cfg`, `t0`; create a world with realm.services.worlds.create_world(s, seed=1, speed=1, player_name='ผู้เล่น', tribe='stonehold', bot_count=0, cfg=cfg, real_now=t0)). Required test cases with hand-computed literals (fresh village: layout 4-4-4-6, speed 1, stock 750 each, rates wood/stone/iron 8/h and food 10/h, capacity 800 each):
- get_village_view at now=t0: buildings has exactly 40 entries for slots 1..40; slot 19 is town_hall level 1 name_th 'ศาลากลาง'; slot 1 is woodcutter level 0; slot 20 has type None, level 0, name_th None; resources 750 each; rates {'wood':8,'stone':8,'iron':8,'food':10}; capacity 800 each; hidden 0; queue_limit 1; build_queue, training, movements, troops_home, reinforcements_here, troops_away empty (troops_home == {}); tribe 'stonehold'; village.population == 2; game_now == now.
- after villages.build woodcutter slot 1 at t0 then view at t0+3600s: build_queue has 1 entry (slot 1, target_level 1, finishes_at t0+240s); resources are settled to now (wood 700 + ... compute with rates after the build: wood rate 8/h until the build completes is NOT modelled; the view just settles with the CURRENT rates, so wood = 700 + 8*1 = 708, food = 700 + 10*1 = 710).
- other player's id -> GameError FORBIDDEN; unknown village -> NOT_FOUND.
- Troops: a Troop row home=village, location=village, unit spearman count 10 -> troops_home == {'spearman': 10}; a second village of the same player holding a Troop (home=other village, location=this village, spearman 4) -> reinforcements_here has one entry with units {'spearman': 4}, troop_ids [that row id], from_village.id == the other village; and the other village's view shows troops_away with location == this village brief and units {'spearman': 4}.
- Movements: an outgoing Movement (from this village, status 'moving', mission 'raid', units {'spearman': 5}) shows direction 'out', hostile False, units {'spearman': 5}; an incoming Movement from ANOTHER player's village with mission 'attack' shows direction 'in', hostile True, units None; a Movement with status 'done' is not listed.
- get_slot_view slot 1 (woodcutter level 0): current.type woodcutter level 0; upgrade.cost == {'wood':50,'stone':90,'iron':40,'food':50}, upgrade.time_s == 240.0, missing [], affordable True; slot 19 (town_hall level 1): upgrade cost level 2 == {'wood':89,'stone':64,'iron':51,'food':76}; empty center slot 20: current None, upgrade None, options contain warehouse (cost {'wood':120,'stone':140,'iron':80,'food':30}, time_s 900.0, missing [], affordable True) and barracks (missing non-empty, affordable False), and contain NO town_hall / woodcutter / wall option; once a warehouse exists in slot 21 (insert Building row), slot 20 options no longer include warehouse; slot 0 or 41 -> GameError INVALID_SLOT.
notes:
DESIGN (follow exactly):
- Both functions: v = lock_village(...); if v.player_id != player_id -> GameError FORBIDDEN (reuse FORBIDDEN_TH); then settle_village(s, v, now, cfg); then read.
- population for VillageBrief = economy.population over ALL building rows as (type, level) pairs. Add a private helper _brief(s, village, cfg) -> VillageBrief.
- resources/rates/capacity: dict via Res.to_dict() from the settled village columns and compute_rates(s, v, now, cfg). hidden = economy.hideout_capacity(levels().get('hideout', 0), player.tribe, cfg).
- buildings: one BuildingView per slot 1..40 (slots.ALL_SLOTS); rows missing -> type None, level 0, name_th None; otherwise name_th = cfg.buildings[type].name_th.
- build_queue: BuildQueue rows of the village ordered by finishes_at -> BuildQueueView. queue_limit = construction.queue_limit(levels().get('town_hall', 0), cfg).
- troops_home: Units of Troop rows with home_village_id == v.id AND location_village_id == v.id (sum counts per unit).
- reinforcements_here: Troop rows with location_village_id == v.id and home_village_id != v.id, grouped by home village: [{'troop_ids': [ids], 'from_village': VillageBrief.model_dump(), 'units': {unit: count}}]. troops_away: Troop rows with home_village_id == v.id and location_village_id != v.id, grouped by location village: [{'location': VillageBrief.model_dump(), 'units': {...}}]. (Plain dicts, since the view fields are list[dict]; use model_dump(mode='json').)
- training: TrainingQueue rows of the village ordered by id -> TrainingView.
- movements: (a) outgoing = Movement rows with from_village_id == v.id and status == 'moving': direction 'out', hostile False, units = row.units, from_village = brief of v, to = Coord(to_x, to_y), to_village_name = name of the village at to_village_id (None when null). (b) incoming = Movement rows with to_village_id == v.id and status == 'moving' whose from_village belongs to a DIFFERENT player than v.player_id: direction 'in', hostile = mission in ('attack','raid','scout'), units = None, from_village = brief of the sender village, to = Coord of v. (c) incoming from the same player (other own village): direction 'in', hostile False, units = row.units. Order everything by arrive_at.
- get_slot_view: slot must be in slots.ALL_SLOTS else GameError INVALID_SLOT. current = BuildingView if a row exists else None. upgrade: only when a row exists and level < construction.max_level(type, v.is_capital, cfg): CostView(cost=building_cost(type, level+1).to_dict(), time_s=build_time_s(type, level+1, town_hall_level, world.speed, cfg), missing=missing_requirements(type, levels, cfg), affordable=(stock covers cost and not missing)). options: only when NO row exists: for every btype in cfg.buildings with slots.slot_accepts(slot, btype, cfg, v.layout), skipping center types that already exist in another slot (building row or build_queue row): {'type', 'name_th', 'cost', 'time_s', 'missing', 'affordable'} for target level 1 (same formulas, use CostView(...).model_dump()-style fields plus type and name_th).
- Use short correct Thai only where a Thai string is needed; check every Thai string for doubled tone marks.
- Keep every existing function in villages.py byte-for-byte unchanged.
